text: Cycling is a popular sport that requires endurance and strength to excel at the pace set by the rhythm of the pedals. One essential component of cycling is the gear system, which determines the efficiency and power output of the rider’s movement. Gears come in various sizes and are arranged on a chainring and sprocket combination, allowing cyclists to adjust their speed and effort according to the terrain and the pace of the race. By changing gears, cyclists can sustain a steady speed or accelerate quickly, making gears a critical component of a well-rounded cycling technique. Additionally, a helmet serves as an essential protective accessory, shielding the rider’s head from impact during falls or collisions, ensuring the safety of the cyclist on both the road and off.
